cases.given: The answer combines factual and counterfactual modes.
cases.expect: Two separated sections with no phase leakage.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the task contains no hypothetical branch
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A factual-only task boundary overrides permission to explore counterfactuals.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: If branch-local assumptions cannot be separated from factual claims, do not certify the mixed output.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: no hypothetical premise or consequence may silently become fact

cases.given: A counterfactual branch assumes intervention X and the final factual summary says X occurred.
cases.expect: Flag phase contamination and remove or relabel the claim.
cases.reject: A pass based only on internal logical consistency of the hypothetical branch.
